aliases: 3MP Indoor Wi-Fi Pan & Tilt Network Camera
features: indoor motorized pan & tilt (Pan 0-355, Tilt -55 to +60)
smart dual light: 10 m IR + 10 m warm light color night vision
AI face recognition, gesture recognition, human & pet detection, auto-tracking
baby crying detection, abnormal sound alarm
two-way talk (dual mic + 2 W speaker), microSD up to 512 GB, DMSS app
release_notes: The Dahua Hero H3JS is a 3MP indoor Wi-Fi 6 pan & tilt camera with smart dual-light color night vision, AI face/gesture/human-pet detection, auto-tracking and two-way talk. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Consumer Wi-Fi camera managed via the DMSS app; ONVIF/RTSP not stated on the datasheet. Add via the Generic Camera integration only if a stream is exposed.

blue_iris.notes: Select the 'Dahua' profile; RTSP is not confirmed on the datasheet.
